scope: Exploratory source-pixel comparisons with caller-selected visual controls; no route ground truth or semantic acceptance. All selected regions are exposed.
coordinateConvention: Original PNG integer pixel-center coordinates; x right, y down, heading from +x toward +y; normal=(-sin heading,cos heading). Integer crop translation only, no resize or S0 canonical conversion.
sampling: Retain full RGBA unchanged; no AA muting, masking, normalization or filtering. All occluder boxes empty: manual windows intentionally avoid sprites where possible; texture/ring overlap may remain.

geometryProvenance.author: D4
geometryProvenance.annotationAuthority: No NorthPark testimony directory exists in pinned testimony tree. Both endpoints are supplied from direct visual inspection in original full screenshot; no tee/badge/hole identity is asserted.
geometryProvenance.brightControl: Bright tan sports-field patch, visually outside the rendered ribbons. Surface/organic identity is unverified; this is a bright non-path hypothesis.

training.apiFieldWarning: tee and badge are API endpoint names only; visual endpoints do not identify sprites or holes

stations.role: matched +12 px normal translation; heading/window unchanged

localWidthBank.meaning: Explicit candidate widths only; no measured width or physical scale

sourceCrop.marginReason: Profile normal offsets +/-30 px plus 2 px reserve; sensor widths max<=48/2, delta2.5 and tangent +/-4 are covered by 32px margin. All declared training endpoints also >=32px from crop bounds.
sourceCrop.geometryBoundsCheck: All profile/sample envelope corner points remain strictly within integer crop; no RGB/edge measurement used.

predeclaredExpectedObservation.ribbon: Some bank widths may return finite paired geometry on the visually straight band; all missing/weak/boundary fits remain literal raw diagnostics.
predeclaredExpectedObservation.matchedOffset: If both poses fit the same physical edges at the same bank width, candidateCenterMinusFitMidpoint(offset)-candidateCenterMinusFitMidpoint(ribbon) should be about +12 source px. No recenter/rerun or parameter adjustment is authorized. Fixed-pose sensor score may decrease; it is not calibrated.
predeclaredExpectedObservation.brightNonpath: Bright non-path may produce positive lanes or paired geometry. Such agreement is a counterexample to semantic path identity, never a false-positive count against independent truth.

predeclaredFalsifier.geometry: Missing baseline pairs, different fitted edge structures, or failure of the signed +12px midpoint difference weakens/falsifies the proposed same-edge translation observation. Retain outcomes at every width without selecting a winning row.
predeclaredFalsifier.semantics: Any bright non-path pair or high channel score defeats using these local channels alone as semantic ribbon identification. Negative non-path output would only show this one region did not match.
predeclaredFalsifier.protocol: Any changed source bytes, resizing, undocumented coordinate translation, insufficient sampling margins, producer execution before release, or output-driven pose/bank adjustment invalidates this freeze.

cases.acceptance: UNKNOWN; no hard score threshold, calibration, path classification or route association.
